title: Module structures for the finite constant completion tower
statement: theorem finiteSystem_module_instances (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) : Nonempty (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Cᵒᵖ), Module (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)) (adicTerm J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) n U))

proof.text: For each n and U, apply RingHom.toModule to the U-component of the constant-presheaf sheafification unit for A/I^(n+1). The underlying ring and additive group of adicTerm J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) n U are definitionally those of this constant quotient sheaf evaluated at U. The resulting action is r • s = eta_U(r) * s. Package this family in Nonempty. This works also for the zero quotient ring and for objects with an empty covering sieve.

proof_origin.description: Direct construction from the constant-presheaf sheafification unit and Mathlib RingHom.toModule; no sectionwise limit theorem is needed.
